_original_lore: The Mutant Tarantula is a Tarantula Broodfather
Miniboss. It spawns very rarely when a player doing
the Tarantula Broodfather Tier IV quest kills a spider.
name: 变异狼蛛 (小首领)

source: The Mutant Tarantula is a Tarantula Broodfather
Miniboss. It spawns very rarely when a player doing
the Tarantula Broodfather Tier IV quest kills a spider.
loreParagraphs.translation: 变异狼蛛是狼蛛母巢猎手的小首领.当进行狼蛛母巢 IV 级任务的玩家击杀蜘蛛时,有极低概率生成.
